report:
Brain, right frontal lesion, stereotactic biopsy

Two smear preparations are made from the tissue. They show a hypercellular fibrillary smear with pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei, mitoses, proliferated vessels and necrotic debris. Sections show three pieces of tissue comprising a diffusely infiltrating, hypercellular astrocytic neoplasm with marked nuclear pleomorphism and hyperchromasia. The tumour shows increased cellularity, nuclear atypia, mitotic activity, microvascular proliferation and necrosis rimmed by pseudopalisading tumour cells. Mitoses number 8 per 10 high-power fields. On immunohistochemistry, the tumour cells are positive for GFAP and OLIG2 and negative for IDH1 R132H, with ATRX retained. The Ki-67 proliferation index is approximately 25 per cent. On molecular testing, a TERT promoter mutation is detected.

BRAIN, right frontal lobe, stereotactic biopsy - GLIOBLASTOMA, IDH-wildtype, CNS WHO grade 4
- Histological appearance: diffuse astrocytic glioma, showing increased cellularity, nuclear atypia, mitotic activity, microvascular proliferation and necrosis rimmed by pseudopalisading tumour cells
- Immunohistochemistry: GFAP positive; OLIG2 positive; IDH1 R132H negative; ATRX retained
- Molecular parameters: TERT promoter mutation detected
- CNS WHO grade 4

MGMT promoter methylation testing has been requested; the result will be issued in a supplementary report.
